goal.authority: Current working-branch owner continuation supersedes older budget stops; cached origin/main is older.

decision_question: Which visible construction gains merit retention, and does attempt03 achieve the full source likeness target?
acceptance_criteria: Coherent head-neck-body silhouette and compact folded shield
Dense readable metal construction and regional worn finish across full bird
Visible gain at fixed before/candidate views

retained_gains.claim: The recessed circular optic and opened mechanical cheek are closer to July head identity; keep their direction while correcting surrounding forms.
Shoulder layering is more readable, exposed neck/chest hardware increases, and larger curved claws improve foot presence. Gains remain partial.

top3_actionable_gaps.claim: Head volume reads as a flat segmented helmet and broad side panel; the crown is pale and slablike, the bill lacks the source’s long forward hooked mass, and rear feathers look like thin cutouts.
top3_actionable_gaps.consequence: Head identity and threatening presence remain materially short of canon.
top3_actionable_gaps.next_test: Rebuild a volumetric hooked bill and swept layered crown around retained optic/cheek landmarks; compare July-head and full-bird views under both fixed lights.

top3_actionable_gaps.claim: Neck-to-breast continuity remains a narrow exposed ribbon entering a broad smooth plated chest; large collar rings look appended. The source has nested armor and machinery that merge head, throat, shoulder and breast into one character.
top3_actionable_gaps.consequence: More components do not create coherent source construction.
top3_actionable_gaps.next_test: Integrate throat plates and machinery into the chest envelope, replace isolated ring accents with layered junctions, and retest the full silhouette plus neck close-up.

top3_actionable_gaps.claim: The full bird still reads as dark simplified armor: shield plates have rounded scalloped edges, machinery is sparse, leg bars remain plain, and enlarged feet read as smooth tubes. Worn metal variation is weaker than canon; workshop light does not resolve it.
top3_actionable_gaps.consequence: Photoreal mechanical density and finish remain absent at character scale.
top3_actionable_gaps.next_test: Sharpen and vary compact shield overlaps; add source-directed exposed leg/foot layered construction and regional metal wear, retaining stance and improved claw envelope. Retest neutral and workshop full-body images.

independence.reviewer: Codex GPT-6 family; exact model unavailable
independence.source_limit: Shared frozen source set; memory used only for evidence-boundary guidance, superseded sequencing checked against current goal.

limitations: One Advanced static build only; three-era delivery, browser parity, eight-angle coverage and animation were not assessed.
Before/candidate views are comparable; source camera calibration is not claimed.
No count/hash result establishes likeness. Owner artistic acceptance remains separate.
review_expiry_trigger: Any source, geometry, material, camera or lighting change requires new frozen images.
